notes: INSIDE half of the Gilded Lance (breech, outward = up; the top flange overhangs the inner wall face, see offset): a laser core, the feed column, power coupling, repair hatch on the wide ones, 5-cell charge strip. charge: frame i lights i of the 5 cells (5 = ready); fire: the strip flashes, then goes dark. damaged: a dead cell, a crack, sparks; disabled: dark, cracked. Module family gun_breech.py (2x2, 4x2, 2x4), in the line of the gun and the race colours of its guns. The rotating head is gilded_lance_barrel.
